editorial-data.role: Primary editorial style for polished data communication; not narrative illustration.

languageRule: Instructions in English. Visible text only in the requested artwork language. Never translate quoted artwork text or mix languages.

editorialDataLayouts.editorial-data-map: Geographic categories or intensity by country/state.
editorialDataLayouts.editorial-data-ranking: Geographic results reinforced by a supplied ranked list.
editorialDataLayouts.editorial-data-event-map: Sourced event locations with dates or counts.
editorialDataLayouts.editorial-data-profile: Sourced named people or profiles tied to countries/regions.
